child.label: Trust, Modesty & Temper
child.description: Questions about whether the answerer trusts people, stays modest rather than boasting, deals honestly rather than for personal gain, and stays easy-going rather than critical or easily annoyed.
child.not_for: Caring about, helping, or cooperating with other people versus confronting, controlling, or getting back at them (use Kindness & Cooperation).
examples: Do you believe most people are basically good?
Do you tend to boast about your achievements?

child.label: Kindness & Cooperation
child.description: Questions about how the answerer treats others: sympathizing with their feelings, helping and making time for them, forgiving, and cooperating versus demanding, controlling, or retaliating.
child.not_for: Trusting people, modesty, honesty for gain, and being easily annoyed or critical (use Trust, Modesty & Temper).
examples: Do you go out of your way to help others?
Do you get back at people who wrong you?
